---
title: "Elqui River Basin Topographic Analysis"
---

::: {.page-subtitle}
**Copernicus GLO-30 · Google Earth Engine · QGIS**
:::

Topographic analysis of the Elqui River Basin in northern Chile using a Copernicus GLO-30 digital elevation model accessed through Google Earth Engine.

![Topographic map of the Elqui River Basin](/images/Mapa_Elqui.jpg){fig-align="center" width="90%" style="margin-left: 1%;"}

---

### Methodology

- Copernicus GLO-30 DEM accessed through Google Earth Engine
- Terrain visualization using hypsometric tint and hillshade
- Elevation profiles generated along selected transects
- Final cartographic layout developed in QGIS

### Results

A detailed topographic map of the Elqui River Basin showing elevation gradients, terrain morphology, and elevation profiles across selected sections of the basin.

### Tools & Data

**Elevation data:** Copernicus GLO-30 DEM  
**Data access:** Google Earth Engine  
**Processing & cartography:** QGIS
